<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Dear Mr. Fahrh&ouml;fer, </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> You have asked me to evaluate the process for the production of
CS Protect-Hydrogel on the basis of the future economic benefits to be achieved for the CS Diagnostics Group as of September 30, 2023.
I would like to comment on this as follows: </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Description and identification of the intangible asset </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&nbsp;</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The CS Protect-Hydrogel is a hydrogel-based tissue spacer. It is
used in radiation therapy to increase the distance between cancer cells and healthy tissue and thus protect healthy tissue from damage
caused by high doses of radiation. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Currently, hydrogel spacers are used exclusively in the treatment
of prostate cancer. Here, the spacer pushes the rectum away from the prostate, thus reducing rectal damage from radiation therapy. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The hydrogel spacer is injected once in liquid form through a thin
needle into the space between cancer cells and healthy tissue and is broken down by the body after about six months. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The CS Protect-Hydrogel is a &quot;ready-to-use&quot; product,
which is sterile packed and can be applied directly. The hydrogel can be used in radiotherapy for prostate, cervical, esophageal, bladder
and breast cancer. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; width: 100%">
<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left">

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The CS Hydrogel was developed by CS Diagnostics Pharma GmbH and
CS Interpharm LLC, both companies of the CS Diagnostics Group, in cooperation with the Rheinisch-Westf&auml;lische Technische Hochschule
Aachen and the DWI - Leibniz-Institut f&uuml;r Interaktive Materialien e.V. The patent application was filed with the German Patent and
Trademark Office in 2023. The applicant for the patent is the DWI - Leibniz Institute for Interactive Materials e.V., which has granted
CS Diagnostics Pharma GmbH an exclusive right to use the invention. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Competitive environment </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&nbsp;</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <U>Competitor products</U> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> In terms of tissue spacers, hydrogel-based as well as hyaluronic
acid-based spacers are used in cancer treatment. However, hyaluronic acid spacers are niche products with a small market share. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> In the case of hydrogel spacers, a competitor product from Boston
Scientific Corporation is currently available on the market. The competitor product SpaceOAR Hydrogel System was developed in 2010 by
Augmentix, Inc. The shares in Augementix, Inc. were fully acquired by Boston Scientific Corporation in 2018 for a fixed purchase price
of USD 500 million plus a variable purchase price component of USD 100 million upon achievement of certain sales targets. The competitor
product has been further developed, is currently marketed under the SpaceOAR Vue Hydrogel trademark, and is approved exclusively for
use in prostate radiation. The product marketed by Boston Scientific Corporation consists of three components that are mixed in a predetermined
sequence and drawn into a syringe by a trained and skilled person. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The molecule of the CS Protect-Hydrogel differs significantly from
the molecule of the competitor product. According to research by the Rheinisch-Westf&auml;lische Technische Hochschule Aachen or the
DWI - Leibniz Institute for Interactive Materials e.V. and the CS Diagnostics Group, patent infringements are not to be expected. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <U>Unique selling proposition (USP)</U> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The CS Protect-Hydrogel is a more advanced hydrogel both from the
molecular structure, chemical physical properties and medical applications. Compared to the competitor product of Boston Scientific Corporation,
CS Protect-Hydrogel has the following practical, hygienic, medical and economic advantages: </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Practical advantages: </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> easy application of the CS Protect-Hydrogel since it is a &quot;ready-to-use&quot;
                                            product </TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> avoidance of a further work step </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Hygienic advantages: </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> immediate application of the CS Protect-Hydrogel after removal from
                                            sterile packaging </TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> no risk of contamination due to preparation and assembly of the product </TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> exclusion of another hygienic risk area within the treatment room </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Medical advantages: </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> no risk of wrong mixture (especially wrong sequence) and therefore
                                            no potential patient's missed appointment </TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> extended application range - besides prostate cancer also for cervical,
                                            esophageal, bladder and breast cancer </TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> hypofractionation possible - significantly fewer treatment sessions
                                            per patient </TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> dose escalation possible - acceleration of radiation therapy </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Economic advantages: </P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> lower personnel costs during treatment due to the elimination of
                                            assistance for mixing the hydrogel </TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> lower room utilization costs per patient as there is no longer a
                                            risk of patients having to be treated again due to incorrect mixtures (higher number of patients
                                            per treatment room) </TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> lower cleaning costs due to the ready-to-use principle </TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> fewer lawsuits and/or insurance claims due to incorrectly mixed hydrogels
                                            requiring the patient to be treated again </TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0in"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"> - </TD><TD> lower purchase price for the clinics than for the competitor product </TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0in"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-indent: 0in"> <U>Market entry barriers</U> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The CS Protect-Hydrogel is a medical device and requires registration
or approval by the respective governmental authorities, in particular the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the USA or the Federal
Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM) after CE testing and certification in Germany. Registration or approval is preceded by
a testing procedure. The CS Diagnostics Group anticipates a period of 6 to 12 months for approval in the U.S. and 6 to 8 months for the
testing procedure and registration of the CS Protect-Hydrogel in Germany. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Since a competitor product is already available on the market and
is used worldwide for prostate irradiation, CS Protect-Hydrogel does not need to be re-explained or advertised for use in prostate irradiation.
Extensive information and advertising is required for the treatment of other types of cancer. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The CS Protect-Hydrogel is a further developed substitute product
for the competing product of Boston Scientific Corporation on the market. Due to the easier handling, the lower medical risks and cost
risks, and the expanded scope of application, the CS Diagnostics Group expects that the respective purchasing departments of clinics
(including specialty clinics) and hospitals will quickly adopt and list the CS Protect-Hydrogel in their portfolios. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Valuation of future economic benefits </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&nbsp;</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <U>Total market and market share</U> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Hydrogel spacers are used in radiotherapy for prostate, esophageal,
bladder, breast and cervical cancer. The use of hydrogel spacers is contraindicated in approximately 10 % of irradiated patients. For
the major markets in the USA and the European Union, the potential use is as follows: </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 4 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2px solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">Seite <!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->4<!-- Field: /Sequence --> von 9&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <DIV STYLE="break-before: page; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 8pt"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%"><TR><TD STYLE="text-align: left; width: 100%"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 8pt">&nbsp;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>
    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> With one application per patient, the annual sales potential of
hydrogel spacers in the European Union and the USA is 385,400 units. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> In addition to the CS Protect-Hydrogel, one competitor product
is used worldwide. The CS Diagnostics Group believes that a market share of approximately 50 % can be achieved for the CS Protect- Hydrogel
in the medium term due to its simpler handling, lower medical risks and cost risks, and expanded scope of application. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <U>Prices and recoverable amounts</U> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"> The competitor product of CS Protect-Hydrogel
is currently offered for sale to clinics and hospitals at market prices ranging from EUR 1,100 to EUR 1,900, with prices of around USD
2,000 in the USA and between EUR 1,100 and EUR 1,800 in the European Union. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The CS Diagnostics Group will position the CS Protect-Hydrogel
as a &quot;ready-to-use&quot; product below these prices. The Group is expected to call selling prices between EUR 1,100 to EUR 1,300
per unit in the European Union and USD 2,000 (i.e. approx. EUR 1,900) per unit in the USA. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> With an expected market share of around 50 %, annual revenues of
EUR 282 million to EUR 303 million would thus be achievable. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <U>Future economic benefits</U> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"> The future economic benefits from the CS Protect-Hydrogel
for the CS Diagnostics Group results from the proceeds from the sale less the manufacturing costs of the hydrogel and the variable distribution
costs. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"> In preliminary discussions of the CS Diagnostics
Group with potential manufacturers of the hydrogel, manufacturing prices between EUR/unit 150 (European Union) to 180 (USA) have been
promised. As variable distribution costs, the CS Diagnostics Group expects 25% of sales revenues. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The CS Diagnostics Group assumes a product life cycle of approximately
10 years from market launch. Market launch is expected after approval or registration of the product in 2025. A compound annual growth
rate (CAGR) of 4.9 % p.a. is assumed for the overall market. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Taking these assumptions into account, the following future cash
flows and their present values as of September 30, 2023 (risk- and maturity-equivalent interest rate of 10 % p.a.) result from the CS
Protect-Hydrogel: </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLSPACING="0" CELLPADDING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; border-collapse: collapse">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
    <TD STYLE="white-space: nowrap; background-color: rgb(225,238,217); vertical-align: middle; width: 24%; text-align: center"> year </TD>
    <TD STYLE="white-space: nowrap; width: 1%"> &nbsp; </TD>
    <TD STYLE="white-space: nowrap; width: 19%; border-bottom: black 1pt solid; background-color: #E1EED9"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: left"> &nbsp; </P>
    <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"> Sales <BR>
    mio. EUR </P></TD>
    <TD STYLE="white-space: nowrap; width: 1%; border-bottom: black 1pt solid; background-color: #E1EED9; text-align: left"> &nbsp; </TD>
    <TD STYLE="white-space: nowrap; width: 15%; border-bottom: black 1pt solid; background-color: #E1EED9"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: left"> &nbsp; </P>
    <P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"> Expenses <BR>
    mio. EUR </P></TD>
    <TD STYLE="white-space: nowrap; width: 3%; border-bottom: black 1pt solid; background-color: #E1EED9; text-align: left"> &nbsp; </TD>
    <TD STYLE="white-space: nowrap; text-align: center; width: 17%; border-bottom: black 1pt solid; background-color: #E1EED9; vertical-align: bottom"><P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0pt"> Profit margin / <BR>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The sum of the present values and thus the future economic benefit
over the expected product life cycle is therefore <B>EUR 961 million</B>. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <U>Sensitivity analysis</U> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The future economic benefit of the CS Protect-Hydrogel is mainly
dependent on market penetration and the achievement of market share as well as the achievable selling prices per unit. Changes in these
assumptions result in the following present values of the future cash flows from CS Protect- Hydrogel for the sales markets of the European

    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 8pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 2px solid"><TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font-size: 10pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: left"><TD STYLE="width: 33%">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 34%; text-align: center">&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="width: 33%; text-align: right">Seite <!-- Field: Sequence; Type: Arabic; Name: PageNo -->8<!-- Field: /Sequence --> von 9&nbsp;</TD></TR></TABLE></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Valuation of the intangible asset </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> <B>&nbsp;</B> </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> The value of the CS Diagnostics Group's right to use CS Protect-Hydrogel
is mainly dependent on the market penetration and the market share achieved as well as the achievable sales prices. In the most likely
scenario of a market share of 50 % and sales prices of EUR/unit 1,100 (EUR (27)) and EUR/unit 1,900 (USA), the economic benefit as the
net present value of future cash surpluses as of September 30, 2023 is <B>EUR 961 million</B>. </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> &nbsp; </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"> Yours sincerely, </P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
